changelog: v2.4.0 - Security hardening: JSON-LD output now encodes <, >, &, ' and " so stored values cannot break out of the script tag (inline-script XSS); nonces unslashed+sanitized before verification; settings tab whitelisted; OG/Twitter image meta stored with esc_url_raw; auto-updater enforces TLS and a GitHub-only package host allowlist; IndexNow only submits same-host URLs. v2.3.0 - Paginated XML sitemap index. v2.2.0 - Person entity, FAQ schema, canonical URLs, enhanced llms.txt, GitHub auto-updater.
